Please give it some attention
Travel Notice for Animal Flyers
If you are bringing a pet on Aurelia Skyways, check the travel basics before you head to the airport and make sure your animal is ready for the trip.

The welfare coordinator checks comfort needs, crate fit, and the general condition of each animal before departure. <<FACT F064>> Keep documents handy, keep food and water plans simple, and be ready to follow the desk team's directions without delay.

For birds, the same calm approach applies. <<FACT F077>> Make sure the carrier is secure, the animal looks settled, and any special care notes are easy for staff to review. If your pet seems unwell, stressed, or unsafe to travel, speak up right away so we can help sort it out.

Keep communication prompt and respectful, and let the team know early about any change in plans. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help, so stop by before boarding for the latest guidance.
